Subject: CSA questionnaire: clarification on CCM control A1.3 scope and evidence expectations

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking this — Argent Tech is working through the CSA CAIQ and we hit a few spots where we need clarification to avoid back-and-forth. Two asks:

1) CCM control A1.3 (administrative access review) — can you confirm the authoritative artifact you expect? Examples from other vendors: monthly audit reports from the IAM provider, or a spreadsheet showing privileged-role attestation.
2) For P2.1 (encryption in transit) you flagged a note about TLS termination in dedicated deployments. Can you provide a short note on what evidence we should expect for a private VPC deployment vs hosted API?

If it's easier, we can accept a short narrative plus pointers to where artifacts live (Drive links), and then follow up for any gaps. We're on a tight audit timeline and trying to consolidate.

Cc: security@argenttech.com

Best,
Lucas
Director of Security — Argent Tech

We will assemble: a short written interpretation (1 page) that explains scope differences, and a small artifact bundle (spreadsheet with control rows mapped to files, and direct Drive links). I attached a draft answers spreadsheet for quick review in the next round.
